title: A hand-edited config ends rehearse and run in a raw traceback
method: introduced one stray comma into the written config and ran rehearse
observed_at_discovery: `cura rehearse` exited 1 with json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes: line 26 column 21, printed as a full stack trace. _preview and _run_scheduled both json.load() with no guard. Hand-editing is the only route the product offers for correcting an answer (setup never re-asks), so this is a likely path, and the output is the stack trace the setup rebuild set out to make impossible.
